summary: A row of cards stores positive point values in cardPoints. Remove exactly k cards. Each removal takes one card from whichever end is currently the left end or the right end. The score equals the sum of the values removed. Write the highest score that can be reached. The row length is from 1 to 100000, each value is from 1 to 10000, and k is from 1 up to the row length.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
